Nadia: small heads-up: the RFC draft references 'meta_tags' as a list, but our client libs prefer sets for idempotency. Should we standardize on array deduping or a canonical comma-separated string?
Owen: Arrays with server-side dedupe is easiest for JSON APIs. We'll document behavior: server trims duplicates, lowercases tags, rejects unknown tags if strict flag set.
Priya: Could we allow tag namespaces like 'perf:low-latency' to encode domain without exploding vocab? Only allow one ':' per tag and enforce safe chars.
Nadia: Agree. Also add a 'tag_policy' in the RFC that lists allowed prefixes and whether tenant-defined custom tags are allowed. Default: no tenant custom tags for routing-critical tags.
schema-bot: Noted. Updated example anchors in draft and added a sample jsonschema snippet.
Owen: minor: cornercase when stability_score missing -> treat as 'unknown' and do not surface warning. We'll set display fallback to 'unrated'.
Priya: Also add a helper function in clients: computeStabilityLabel(score) -> stable|degraded|unknown. Docs will show thresholds.
Nadia: Great. I'll fold these into the RFC. Ship it tomorrow.
